ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 75% low-intensity (dark) to 25% high-intensity (light) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (black) region covering the central and inner lobe areas. A distinct, large contiguous high-intensity (white) region is mapped on the distal half of the right lobe. Minor high-intensity mottling is visible at the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex and significant depth relative to the overall lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge (top boundary) exhibits a mostly smooth continuous line with low-amplitude, high-frequency micro-serrations localized near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch to the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast (grey/white) protrusions corresponding to barnacle colonization are localized on the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected, predominantly oriented vertically on the central-left and central-right dark regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the leading edge boundaries; significant linear rake marks across the central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the lobes, characterized by the large white patch on the right lobe versus the nearly solid black left lobe.
